solution.name: Abandoned cart SMS
solution.metaTitle: Abandoned cart SMS on your own account
solution.metaDescription: A recovery text for the checkout they left, on the SMS account the store already owns, connected inside Shopify.
solution.lede: The recovery text is about that checkout: the store’s name, a return link, and the offer, sent from the SMS account the store already pays for.

p: The recipient is the shopper who reached payment and stopped. The text names the store, carries the return link, and can include the discount code.
It goes out on the store’s own timing, separate from the two emails, so the email and the text can land in the order the store wants.

Connect the provider inside the Shopify app. The store keeps the provider relationship, the rate, the sender identity, and the invoice. Whaleal does not resell message volume and does not add a fee on that bill.

In practice that means the regulatory work stays where it belongs: sender registration, local consent rules and the limits your provider grants are all on your side. We route the message and log the send; we do not file or guarantee the rest.

sections.h: The delay is yours to set
p: The text has its own send delay, independent from the email sequence. That lets you run the two channels in a deliberate order — email first and a text only for the checkouts that are still open, or the reverse — instead of firing everything at the same minute.
bullets: Own send time, independent of the email sequence
A template with the shop name, the discount code, and the return link
A short link when the store turns one on
The send sits beside the email history

p: A text that arrives while the customer is still on their phone reads as helpful. The same text an hour later reads as tracking. Set the delay against your own buying cycle and watch recovered orders — not send volume — to decide whether it was right.

Messaging consent and opt-out compliance in the countries you text, sender ID and number registration, the quotas and rate limits your provider grants, and the accuracy of the message you write. These are between you and your provider.

faq.q: Do I have to use my own SMS provider?
faq.a: Yes. Connect the account inside the Shopify app. The rate, the sender identity, and the invoice stay with the provider.

faq.q: Can I send marketing campaigns through this channel?
faq.a: Cart uses the text to bring that checkout back to pay. Sending beyond a single checkout is Whaleal Platform, on the same kind of account the store already owns.

faq.q: Can I turn the text channel off and keep emails?
faq.a: Yes — the two channels are independent. Run email alone, text alone, or both with different delays.
